tasks.name: Scan libraries
tasks.description: Full scan of the folders: added, deleted or replaced files. Additions are normally detected continuously; this full pass serves as a check.

tasks.name: Refresh metadata
tasks.description: Reloads summaries, posters, cast and episode titles from TMDB (and the .nfo files). Manual identifications are kept.

option_defs.label: What to refresh
choices: Only what is incomplete (unidentified, no summary or poster)
What has not been refreshed for a while
Everything (long: one TMDB request per movie and per season)

option_defs.label: Minimum age (if “not refreshed for a while”)

tasks.note: Without a TMDB key, only the .nfo files are reread.

tasks.name: Sync with Trakt
tasks.description: For each account linked to Trakt: watched items, ratings and the watchlist go both ways. Nothing is removed.
tasks.note: Register the Trakt application in Settings → Trakt and Letterboxd.

tasks.name: Extract chapter images
tasks.description: One image per chapter, shown in the player's chapter selection and on the title page. Only files with at least two chapters are concerned.

option_defs.label: Also run after files are added
option_defs.hint: New episodes and movies are processed as soon as they are scanned.

option_defs.label: Pause during playback
option_defs.hint: Frees the network share and the processor during playback.

tasks.name: Detect intros and credits
tasks.description: For episodes without named chapters: compares the audio fingerprint of the episodes of a season to find the opening (“Skip intro” button) and the end credits (“Next episode” card). At least two episodes are needed in the season.

option_defs.label: Also run after files are added
option_defs.hint: New episodes and movies are processed as soon as they are scanned.

option_defs.label: Look for the intro in the first
Look for the credits in the last
Minimum length of an intro / credits
Skip episodes whose chapters already mark the intro
Pause during playback
option_defs.hint: Frees the network share and the processor during playback.

tasks.name: Prepare subtitles and previews
tasks.description: Queues the files whose embedded subtitles or seek bar thumbnails are not ready yet. Preparation runs outside of playback.

tasks.name: Download missing subtitles
tasks.description: Searches OpenSubtitles for subtitles in the chosen languages (Settings → Subtitles and audio) for movies and episodes that have none, newest first. Stops at the account's daily quota and resumes the next day.

option_defs.label: Also run after files are added
option_defs.hint: New episodes and movies are processed as soon as they are scanned.

tasks.note: Enter the OpenSubtitles account in Settings → Subtitles and audio.

tasks.name: Generate missing subtitles (Whisper)
tasks.description: Transcribes the speech of movies and episodes with no subtitles in the spoken language, after OpenSubtitles. Very long without a graphics card or a dedicated service: keep it for off-peak hours.

option_defs.label: Pause during playback
option_defs.hint: Frees the network share and the processor during playback.

tasks.note: Set a transcription service (Settings → Subtitles and audio → Whisper)

tasks.name: Refresh channels and TV guide
tasks.description: Reloads the channel lists (M3U) and programmes (XMLTV) of the Live TV sources.

option_defs.label: Check that each channel responds
option_defs.hint: A channel that fails to respond twice in a row is hidden, then shown again as soon as it responds. Channels are tested one at a time.

tasks.name: Clean up caches
tasks.description: Deletes resized images unused for a long time, and the subtitles, previews, chapter images and fingerprints of files no longer in the libraries.

tasks.name: Back up the server
tasks.description: Copies the database (accounts, history, ratings, playlists, settings, libraries), the keys for linked servers and notifications, and profile pictures into an archive. Videos and photos are not included.

tasks.name: Free up space (cold storage)
tasks.description: Titles nobody has watched for the chosen number of days (Settings → Cold storage): suggested, or copied automatically to cold storage, then their file leaves the library once the delay is over. No effect until the rule is turned on.
